place: Agatti Island Coral Atoll and Airport Lagoon
text: Agatti Island (Malayalam: [ɐɡɐt̪ːi]) is a 7.6 km long island, situated on a coral atoll called Agatti atoll in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep, India. It is 459 km (285 mi) west of the city of Kochi.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
